digest.component_or_area: bridge-state projects store, tickets-branch mutation seams
propositions: projects_store._write_record bypasses shared fsutil.atomic_write and hand-rolls mkstemp/os.replace, violating the tickets-branch write-lock + commit-push invariant
projects_store.set_project and remove_project never acquire write_lock, commit, or push, causing mutations to escape the unified seam layer

the hand-rolled write path in projects_store must be converted to use fsutil.atomic_write (preserving byte-identical serialization with json.dumps indent=2 sort_keys=True + newline) while keeping path.parent.mkdir before the call
all projects.json mutations must run their read-modify-write under lock.write_lock, then call push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch to auto-commit and publish, with no ad-hoc git operations
the concurrency.md documentation must explicitly state the two-part invariant: every tickets-branch mutation runs under write_lock AND auto-commits+publishes
